sources.result: The current company news index retained the June 1 eight-state asset-sale close and February 25 Nevada/Oregon asset-sale announcement, with no platform equity sale or sponsor exit after the stored research cutoff.
The board page was current in July 2026 and continued to identify an operating Nexus platform with BCI infrastructure representation.
The company continued to describe the 2024 SouthWest Water and Corix combination as the formation of Nexus Water Group and its Sugar Land headquarters.

notes: The identified 2026 sales remain subsidiary asset divestitures, not a change in Nexus platform ownership.
